name: Paint a Manga! 🎨 [NO LIMIT ♾️]
desc:
🎨 Paint a Manga!

Recreate your favourite manga covers pixel by pixel, just by walking across the canvas!

🖼️ Search almost any manga cover from a live database.
🎨 Paint by numbers using the colour palette.
👥 Play with up to 6 players in real time.
💾 Auto-save lets you continue anytime.
🏆 Unlock completed covers and beat your best times.

🔄 Shutdown = Update

🚧 Beta: More features and improvements are coming soon. Thanks for playing!

scripts.title: Volaris Hub | FASTEST Auto Paint, MAX Walkspeed, Queue cover
scripts.features:
WARNING! The script may take a while to initialise (due to the library). Upon first execution, patiently wait till the UI shows!

Simple, user-friendly, keyless script for Paint a Manga!.

Please consider liking this post! ❤️

Offers features like:
- Auto paint module (Walks to the studs)
- Blatant mode (teleports to far studs)
- Walkspeed modifier (Spoof 2x walkspeed)
- Live stats + ETA
- Queueing covers (Add specific translation or volumes of a manga, or bulk add all)
- Anti-AFK
- Staff watchdog (Server hops when an important player is detected)
- Rainbow studs (Loops through colours for better visibility of studs)
- Always on hint-pillars (Uses game's hint pillars to constantly show location of studs)
- tracer lines (ESP-like tracer lines that show stud location)


Depending on your executor, the script may not run/load. Please use a mid to high-level executor, or one that supports these functions:
- loadstring
- game:HttpGet
- getgenv
- getconnections (optional)
- getupvalue (optional)
- gethui (recommended)
- File API (writefile, readfile, isfolder, makefolder, delfile) (optional)
- Actor API (VERY recommended!)


Currently, there is no Discord server, so if you wish to report an issue, do so in the GitHub: https://github.com/flyrbo/Volaris

Please use the script responsibly like by not being blatant, using an alt account, etc. The Script is also open source, so feel free to fork it and improve it as you see fit (credits would be appreciated of course).
